summary: Iteration 18: Verified new Refund feature end-to-end. Backend endpoints (POST /api/support/refund, GET /api/admin/refunds, POST /api/admin/refunds/{id}/decide) and Settings Legal Information section + Admin Refund Requests tab all working per spec. 10/10 backend pytest tests pass; full frontend Playwright flow passes (legal order, static content, refund form validation, submit success, admin approve).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1600 lines — consider splitting refund/admin/support routers into separate modules for maintainability.

RefundBody accepts any string starting with 'data:' (not strictly image); backend does secondary check startswith('data:') then compresses only if data:image/. Consider tightening MIME validation to reject non-image data URLs.
Rate limit uses count_documents with iso-string comparison ('$gte': iso(since)); works only because timestamps stored as ISO strings — noted for consistency.
AdminPage RefundsTab success toast is Russian ('Обновлено') while surrounding refund UI is English — mild i18n inconsistency (not blocking).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@lovreski.ru / LovreskiAdmin2026! ; ephemeral test users registered via /api/auth/register per test run.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users prefixed ref_/rl_/appr_/rej_<ts>@lovreski.ru and refund_requests documents. No cleanup performed (uses unique timestamps).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest expects REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var — run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_refund_iter18.py -v . Frontend uses localStorage key 'lovreski_token' for auth. Playwright script covered legal ordering, all 4 legal contents (terms/payment/security/refund), refund form validation (submit disabled until name/email/reason/receipt all present), successful POST, and admin approve via /admin/refunds/{id}/decide.
